integrity: Analytic proof is presented and a standalone standard-library checker is supplied. Numerical experiments are corroborative rather than a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform samples from a Euclidean unit-circle boundary only; fixed finite microscopic angular sites and fixed radial boundary-depth window. No global-process, uniform-in-location, general-convex-curve, or independent priority theorem. Jewell–Romano 1982 complete text was inaccessible; priority remains provisional.
title: The local Poisson-chord law and exact radial-error covariance of random cyclic polygons
